description: Hermes Desktop for macOS, the DMG the vendor's stable feed serves, found by its bundle id.
why: The app is installed and never launched, so its bundle id is the only witness: a first launch writes ~/.local/bin/hermes and ~/.hermes, which the hermes entry already carries. must_contain names the id as well, so a rename turns this red even if something else on the runner ever named Hermes. Nothing is forbidden: no catalogued agent shares the com.nousresearch namespace.
known_gaps: Not launched, so running_apps is not exercised for Hermes, and what the app writes on first run is read only on the probe run the catalog cites.
The source-built desktop (`hermes desktop`, bundle id com.nousresearch.hermes) and the remote-only Light client are other bundle ids, and neither is installed here.
